name: Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (HDRS-17 / HAM-D-17)
directions: Clinician-rated after a structured clinical interview. Rate the past week using the authorized HDRS-17 anchors. Item 16 is rated using either the patient report or weekly measurements method. This is a severity measure, not a diagnosis or safety assessment.

questions.text: Insomnia: early hours of the morning
Loss of weight (patient report or weekly measurements)

attribution: Hamilton M. A rating scale for depression. J Neurol Neurosurg Psychiatry. 1960;23:56–62. The supplied text identifies the HDRS as public domain. HDRS-17 selected; other versions are not interchangeable.
